summary.text: John Schneller is a Republican state representative from Hillsborough 2 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Schneller has worked as a chief financial officer for a financial technology firm, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: John Schneller earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Massachusetts Amherst and graduate degrees from Suffolk University and Cornell University.
Ballotpedia lists his affiliations as the Bedford Town Council, Bedford School Board, Bedford Energy Commission, the Bedford School Curriculum Committee and the Bedford Men's Club.
Schneller lost the Hillsborough 2 general election in 2022 and won it in 2024, according to Ballotpedia's campaign finance records.
